recognition.summary: Recognition covers accepted High/Critical reports or more than five new valid Medium/Low reports within 90 days.

reporting.summary: Current policy expressly accepts direct email; a Bugcrowd submission link is an additional option.

rewards.summary: No monetary promise is established by the reviewed pages; historical platform points are not cash.

limitations: Count the group once. The Hall still mentions HackerOne points while current policy links Bugcrowd; their current availability is not verified. Public disclosure requires express consent even after resolution.
rights: Original summary CC BY 4.0; linked sources and trademarks retain their own rights.
